$comment: A gate nobody has watched fail is a gate nobody should believe. This config is expected to FAIL, and CI asserts that it does; if it ever passes, the contrast check has stopped checking and every green run above it means nothing.

The failing pair is not arbitrary. It is --pw-bevel-light against the face it sits on, at the 3:1 an edge would need, and it measures 1.47:1. That is the exact pair the real config deliberately does not check, because the white inner highlight of a bevel identifies nothing on its own and forcing it to 3:1 would make it grey. So this fixture does two jobs: it proves the gate fires, and it records why that pair is exempt in the one place nobody can quietly delete without the build going red.

pairs.label: expected to fail: the bevel highlight is decoration, not a boundary
